subject: Activation playline & MAP — Catalystone close-to-live cadence
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Brooks <avery.brooks@catalystone.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@catalystone.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Activation playline & MAP — Catalystone close-to-live cadence

Hi Avery / Priya,

Congrats again on closing — excited to get the implementation cadence locked in. Attached is our initial Activation Playline (MAP embedded) that sequences rollout, canary, migration, and training activities for a close-to-live target of Nov 20. High-level ask: please confirm the following by EOD Friday so we can lock training cohorts and provisioning windows:

- Canary window: Nov 6–8 (3 days, 10% traffic)
- Staged migration: Nov 9–15 (regional rollups, nights)
- Training: two hands-on sessions (Nov 13, Nov 16) plus async materials
- Acceptance evals: end-to-end smoke + quality checks during canary; pass-rate target 95% on our eval prompts

I've included an initial canary checklist and a training roster template. Key owners are noted in the MAP: Delivery (Marissa), Runtime Ops (Jonas), Customer Success (Monica). If you want to shift the canary earlier/later, flag any blackout dates.

Attachments: Catalystone_ACTIVATION_PLAYLINE_v1.pdf, Catalystone_canary-checklist.csv, training-roster-catalystone.xlsx

Thanks — happy to run a 30m sync tomorrow if that's easier.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin | Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Avery Brooks <avery.brooks@catalystone.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-03T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation playline & MAP — Catalystone close-to-live cadence

Thanks Chloe — this looks good at first pass. A couple items before we sign off:

1) Procurement needs a final SOW and invoice timeline (cc'ing Procurement). They expect final paperwork by Oct 11.
2) For the canary, our security team will require audit logging enabled and a readout on data residency for the small test cohort — can Jonas and the infra team confirm those two points?
3) Training participants: we can commit one engineer + two product owners for the Nov 13 session; Nov 16 may only have product owners available.

Can you route a short SOW addendum and call out the audit/logging controls in the MAP?

—Avery
Avery Brooks | Sr. Product Ops | Catalystone HealthTech
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation playline & MAP — Catalystone close-to-live cadence

Looping in ops owners. Jonas — can you confirm the audit logging & data residency notes? I'll draft a concise SOW addendum for procurement and share it by Oct 6 so procurement has time to review.

Also adding two small changes to the MAP (I'll attach v1.1 once updated):
- Add explicit rollback gates (0–8 hr, 24 hr, 72 hr checkpoints) tied to latency and error thresholds
- Detail the eval prompt set we'll run during canary and the pass/fail thresholds (we propose 95% pass on key intents; see eval matrix)

Marissa
Director, Delivery | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Brooks <avery.brooks@catalystone.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-03T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation playline & MAP — Catalystone close-to-live cadence

Hi Avery — quick confirmation from infra:

- Audit logging: can enable request-level audit logs for the canary cohort and deliver the audit bundle within 48 hours of request. Logs will include token-level latency and request hashes (PII redaction enabled).
- Data residency: canary workload can be pinned to us-west-2 (complies with your regional requirement).
- We'll also add an automated smoke job that runs the eval prompt set every 30 minutes during the 3-day canary and feeds results into the MAP dashboard.

If you need the log format sample, I can attach a scrubbed example.

Jonas
Infra Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Nair <priya.nair@catalystone.com>

Also, Chloe/Marissa — please include a short training agenda for the Nov 13 session; product owners need to see the hands-on labs outline before the 13th.

I'll confirm attendee list by Oct 9.

Subject: Re: Activation playline & MAP — Catalystone close-to-live cadence

Thanks all — next steps:

1) Marissa will publish MAP v1.1 (adds rollback gates + eval matrix) by Oct 6.
2) I will circulate a 1-page SOW addendum for Procurement by Oct 5 (includes invoice timing).
3) Jonas to attach a scrubbed audit-log example and confirm the automated smoke job config.
4) Priya to confirm attendees by Oct 9 so we can finalize the training roster.

I'll attach v1.1 and the canary checklist to the shared Drive link and update the HubSpot deal record with the milestones. Please reply with any objections; absent objections we'll lock the schedule on Oct 11 when Procurement confirms the SOW.

Chloe
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
